source.title: Home | Unique Little Ones
source.raw_text:
Welcome | 欢迎
Unique Little Ones is a bilingual kindergarten where children learn in English and Mandarin every day, through stories, songs and play.
Unique Little Ones 创立于 2006 年，致力于为孩子提供快乐而扎实的双语教育。
Programmes | 课程
Our programmes cover literacy, numeracy, science and the arts, with small classes and caring teachers.
Curricular Activities | 课间活动
孩子们每周参加书法、武术、舞蹈和华语故事时间，在活动中认识中华文化。
Testimonials | 家长心声
孩子在这里非常开心，每天回家都会唱新学的歌，老师们也很用心。—— 陈太太
我们很满意这里的双语环境，孩子的华语和英语都进步了很多。—— 林先生
Enrolment | 报名
Enrolment for next year is open now. Visit our centre to meet the teachers and see the classrooms.

discovered_pages.title: About | Unique Little Ones
discovered_pages.raw_text:
About Us | 关于我们
We started with one classroom and a belief that children can grow up comfortable in two languages.
我们从一间教室开始，相信孩子可以在两种语言中自在地成长。
Our Teachers | 我们的老师
Every teacher speaks both English and Mandarin and holds an early childhood qualification.
